title: Leeuwis2021: Left- vs right-hand motor-imagery EEG dataset
description: Single-session EEG recordings of left- versus right-hand motor imagery from 55 healthy, BCI-naive participants, collected to study psychological and cognitive predictors of motor-imagery brain-computer interface performance. Data were recorded with 16 channels at 250 Hz and include one calibration run without feedback plus three feedback runs. This BIDS version was generated from the DataverseNL source deposit via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.Nautilus 16-channel system (g.tec) at 250 Hz, referenced to the right earlobe with ground at AFz. Each participant completed one calibration run without feedback and three feedback runs of 40 trials each (20 left, 20 right), cued visually. Participants imagined moving the left or right hand.
